name: Azeroth Companion
title: Sovereign Intelligence — Character & Equipment Research
features: Added Character Intelligence inside Live Armory with source-backed summaries from already returned public Blizzard profile and equipment data.
Display returned equipment count, item-level field coverage and range, and Blizzard-reported average item level with explicit missing-data labels.

No extra Blizzard requests, no new account permissions, no automatic gear recommendations, simulated DPS or inferred item ownership.
Preserved Talent Forge, music, saved data, archived studios and the established Discord release announcement workflow.
